metadata.name: Build an illustrated HTML table in Phoenix Pro
metadata.description: Insert and style the Trail Notes table in Design Mode. Name the columns, add an illustrated caption, duplicate the first row, and check the two saved distances.

instructions: In Design Mode, click the pen to turn on editing.
Select the Contact link, then click Insert Element (+).
Choose Before. Search for table.
Choose Table, the result with the grid icon.
Click table on the blue toolbar to open its properties.
Under Class, type trail-table and press Enter.
Double-click each heading. Enter Trail and Distance.
Name the first trail Pine Loop and set it to 2 km.
Click Trail. Use the up arrow twice to select thead.
Click Insert Element (+). Choose Before and search for caption.
Choose the Create caption result to add the banner.
Double-click the banner. Enter Trail distances.
Click Save File. Check Pine Loop at 2 km.
Double-click 2 km and change it to 3 km.
Click Pine Loop, then the up arrow to select the row.
Click Duplicate to make a second row.
In the second row, enter Lake Walk and 4 km.
Click Save File, then turn off the pen.
Check the saved trails and the Contact link below.

metadata.name: Build an illustrated HTML table in Phoenix Code Community
metadata.description: Use Highlight Mode to find the insertion point in about.html. Paste the table, change Pine Loop to 3 km, add Lake Walk at 4 km, and check both rows in Live Preview.

instructions: Choose Highlight Mode beside the pen.
Click the last bullet to find its HTML.
Press Enter just after the closing list tag.
Paste the table from the guide with Edit → Paste.
Save about.html. Pine Loop starts at 2 km.
In the first row, change 2 km to 3 km.
Press Enter just after the first row’s closing tag.
Paste the Lake Walk row inside the table body.
Save. Check Pine Loop at 3 km and Lake Walk at 4 km.
